title: Class 6th Science - Ch 1 Components of Food

questions.question: Which nutrient gives maximum energy per gram?
questions.explanation: Fats provide more than double the energy per gram compared to carbohydrates.

questions.question: Scurvy is caused due to deficiency of:
questions.explanation: Deficiency of Vitamin C leads to bleeding gums and Scurvy.

questions.question: Iodine test is used to detect the presence of:
questions.explanation: Blue-black color with iodine solution confirms Starch.

questions.question: Which mineral is required for strong bones?
questions.explanation: Calcium is essential for healthy bones and teeth.
